forecast-period.text: A high pressure system over the Tasman Sea extends a ridge across southern SA. A low pressure system in the far northwest and associated trough moves across the west and north of the State on Thursday then central and eastern parts on Friday. A ridge of high pressure extends into the west later Friday and over the weekend. On Monday the high pressure centre moves over waters to the south.
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones.

Possible showers and thunderstorms about central and eastern districts, possibly severe in the far east. Showers and thunderstorms contracting to eastern districts in the evening. Maximum temperatures above average, about the agricultural areas grading to below average in the west and north. East to northeasterly winds in the east, with south to southwesterly winds extending throughout during the day.

Showers and thunderstorms about the Flinders and Pastoral districts and in the west, possibly severe in the far north and far west. Generally southeast to northeasterly winds, fresh and gusty at times in the north.

Showers about the agricultural area, most likely about coastal parts and the Lower South East. Slight chance of a thunderstorm about the eastern border. Maximum temperatures near average about eastern parts, grading to below average in the west. South to southwesterly winds, fresh at times near coastal parts.
Light showers about the southern agricultural, most likely about southern coasts and ranges. Maximum temperatures below average. Southwest to southeasterly winds.

text.p: Light morning showers about the southern agricultural area. Maximum temperatures below average. Fresh south to southwesterly winds.

Cumulative rainfall totals to the end of Monday: Generally less than 5 mm about the agricultural areas, 2 to 10 mm elsewhere increasing to 10 to 25 mm west of about Ceduna to Coober Pedy, north of Coober Pedy, the Flinders district and near the eastern border. Local falls of 30 to 60 mm possible with thunderstorms mainly about the Pastoral districts.
